flow_steps: 1. Offline synthetic OHLCV multi-timeframe market watch fixture generated (1m/5m/15m/1h/4h)
2. Scanner assessed symbol BTCUSDT -> Direction LONG, Entry Quality EXCELLENT, Data Quality OK
3. Immutable CasePackageV1 built with deterministic case_hash and 120s TTL
4. Mocked ResponsesBackend produced primary AnalysisResultV1 (model=gpt-5.4, confidence=0.92, thesis_strength=0.85, action=OPEN_LONG)
5. DecisionFusion selected OPEN_LONG without requiring manual review
6. RiskCompilerV1 compiled TradeProposalV1 (leverage capped at 3x <= policy max 3x, notional capped at ~200 USDT <= policy max 500 USDT)
7. Mock Feishu interactive card template constructed with action buttons
8. Human callback APPROVE recorded into LiveStore with event_id=preview-appr-evt-001
9. AccountWatch produced reconciled AccountSnapshotV1 in paper mode
10. build_trade_intent created immutable TradeIntentV1 bound to approval_event_id and case_hash
11. PreExecutionValidator verified intent, market observation (spread < 10 bps, drift < 50 bps), and account snapshot
12. DryRunExecutionBackend executed simulated entry order (FILLED, qty=1.998, avg_price=100.1) and placed simulated protective stop order
13. LiveExecutionService verified exactly-once execution (subsequent execution returned RECONCILED fill with 0 duplicate orders)
14. PositionSupervisor recorded position observation into live_position_events (POSITION_OPENED, STOP_NEAR) and updated live_position_lifecycle_v2

scenarios.scenario: Path A: LLM Refusal / Provider Failure
scenarios.result: AnalysisResultV1.fail_closed produced NO_ACTION with risk_modifier=BLOCK; RiskCompiler produced proposal with MODEL_BLOCK and requires_manual_review=True; NO trade intent can be created.
DecisionFusion flagged MODEL_DISAGREEMENT and set requires_manual_review=True; unapproved automated execution is prohibited.
LiveStore recorded REJECTED state; build_trade_intent failed closed with ExecutionBlocked: approval record does not match proposal or case.
LiveStore rejected approval callback with ValueError: proposal expired; state transitioned to EXPIRED.

scenarios.scenario: Path E: Forged / Tampered Proposal Hash
scenarios.result: LiveStore rejected mismatched callback identity with ValueError: stale or mismatched callback identity.

scenarios.scenario: Path F: Duplicate Callback Collision and Replay
scenarios.result: Differing callback event rejected with ValueError: callback event collision; identical replay returned replay=True without re-transitioning.
